Add the documented audit npm script to package.json with the exact command from RUNBOOK.md. Preserve all existing fields and scripts and add nothing else.
Add the documented report npm script to package.json with the exact command from OPERATIONS.md. Preserve all existing fields and scripts and add nothing else.
Fix effectiveConcurrency so an explicit 0 is preserved while null or undefined uses the default 4. Preserve false and empty-string inputs and keep the exported API.
Fix effectivePrefix so an explicit empty string is preserved while null or undefined uses the default citadel-. Preserve 0 and false inputs and keep the exported API.
Fix readOption so option names are matched case-insensitively, the first matching value is returned, invalid input returns null, and the entries are not mutated. Preserve the API.

Repair isAllowedContentType so it accepts application/json case-insensitively with optional surrounding spaces or a semicolon charset=utf-8 parameter, and rejects every other type, parameter, or non-string. Preserve the API.
Repair isRelativeResource so it accepts a non-empty relative resource path but rejects absolute paths, dot segments, slash or backslash traversal, NUL, URL schemes, and non-strings. Preserve the API.
Make decodeEnvelope the canonical export, retain decodeLegacy as the same function object, and update reader.js to import and call the canonical name. Change exactly the two declared source files.
Repair copyOwnMetadata so it copies only own enumerable properties and rejects __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys. It must not mutate input or pollute prototypes. Preserve the API.
